reference.purpose: Desktop geometry, default Material styling and lock-screen visual reference; upstream shell code is not deployed

implementation: Original repository-owned Quickshell shell and Lua configuration
package_policy: Official Arch packages by default; full-system upgrades; no partial package holds

bundled_assets.usage: Lock screen only; desktop wallpaper remains user-owned

theme: Original desktop gradient and system typography; ii-inspired top bar and desktop clock; native Hyprlock with the user-provided sunset wallpaper, blue reference clock, adaptive keyboard-layout pill and power/reboot controls
font_policy: Uses installed system fonts; no font files are distributed by this repository

shortcuts.scope: Supported non-AI reference shortcuts and aliases, preserving existing ArchSetup bindings
